name: Montezuma
source:
"I don't know why, but I got angry! That's why I bit you!"

Based on Montezuma, who was the ninth Aztec emperor of Tenochtitlan (an Aztec city-state that no longer exists), reigning from 1502 to 1520.

A hero of the Azteca given the duty of guarding the sacred grounds. Montezuma is very obsessed with food, especially meat, and will eat any animal that looks edible. She hates vegetables. Montezuma is good friends with the nearby Incan leader [url=/c5201]Huanya Capac[/url], and they are often in contact.

[From [url=http://fruitbatfactory.com/eiyuusenki/char.html#char09a]English official site[/url]]
